assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md Step 1 table lists: CVE ID = CVE-2026-31812, Vulnerable library = quinn-proto, Affected version range = 'versions before 0.11.14 (< 0.11.14)', Fixed version = 0.11.14 (lines 42-48).

assertion_results.text: The analysis presents triage recommendations as proposed actions -- framing Affects Versions changes, label additions, and status transitions as proposals rather than executed mutations (Guardrails)
assertion_results.evidence: All outputs consistently use proposal framing. data-extraction.md line 3: 'Proposed Actions (not executed)'. affects-versions.md line 29: 'Proposed Correction', line 52: 'Proposed Jira Operation (not executed)', line 66: 'Proposed Comment (not executed)'. remediation.md line 252: 'Proposed Jira Operations (not executed)', line 342: 'Post-Triage Summary (proposed, not executed)'. No output claims to have executed any mutation.

assertion_results.text: Release orchestration preserves interactive confirmation of the exact release Epic version and separate child Task creation; when release evidence or confirmation is unavailable, it reports pending work instead of claiming creation.
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md Step 7.5 (lines 1-45): For the applicable 2.1.x stream, it uses conditional framing 'If release Jira orchestration were applicable:' and states 'Engineer confirmation required for both Epic and Task creation' (line 32). It reports pending work ('Would propose creating') rather than claiming creation. Preemptive tasks are correctly excluded from release Jira linking per Step 7.5 scope (line 19).

assertion_results.text: Release dedup is skipped when its Upstream Affected Component configuration is absent. When trusted release evidence is available, the proposed procedure resolves originating CVEs through Blocks/Depend links, compares their components and allows library-summary fallback only for a missing Depend link or component field; a known nonmatch does not count as dedup, and unavailable release evidence is not fabricated.
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md Step 7.5.3 (lines 37-44): 'The Upstream Affected Component custom field is not configured in Security Configuration. Per Step 7.5.3 prerequisite: Requires the Upstream Affected Component custom field to be configured. If not configured, skip dedup and proceed to Step 8.' Decision: 'Dedup check is skipped entirely. Proceeding directly to Step 8 remediation task creation.' No release evidence is fabricated; the analysis correctly identifies the absent configuration and skips dedup.
